title: Central Mindanao University grad tops foresters licensure exam
summary: A graduate of Central Mindanao University took the top spot in the licensure examination for professional foresters, given earlier this month.

blocks.text: A graduate of Central Mindanao University took the top spot in the licensure examination for professional foresters, given earlier this month.

According to the Professional Regulation Commission (PRC), 1,406 test takers out of 1,892 passed the exam, given by the Board for Foresters at test enters in Metro Manila, Baguio, Butuan, Cagayan de Oro, Cebu, Davao, Iloilo, Koronadal, Legazpi, Lucena, Pagadian, Pampanga, Rosales, Tacloban and Tuguegarao.

Joey Siarez Jumawan of Central Mindanao University achieved the highest score of 94.10%, while the top performing school with 50 or more examinees is the University of the Philippines-Los Baños, with all 129 of its test takers passing.
